mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 115.0 signals manufacturing supply chain constraints that increase corporate costs and reduce output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 115.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales level above prior month's value indicates strong consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS rises from prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation above 195.0 (CPIAUCSL) triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 195.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment and rises in unemployment signal labor market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate hiring, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market slowdown below 2000.0 units signals reduced consumer spending on durable goods, lowering corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 2000.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
